title: Lena and the Verdict
author: Ulyana Ravensworth
blurb: Juniper Yarrow, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
